description: Starts a free readiness diagnostic for an FAA knowledge test: returns 10-20 quiz questions (answers hidden) spread across the exam's areas — for Part 107 in proportion to the official FAA weights. Each question has a question_id; scoring the set of answers gives the result per area, how it compares with the pass mark and a suggested next step.

exam.description: FAA knowledge test: part107 (drone / Remote Pilot, UAG), ppl (Private Pilot Airplane, PAR), ifr (Instrument Rating Airplane, IRA), cpl (Commercial Pilot Airplane, CAX), atp (Airline Transport Pilot Multiengine, ATM).

name: diagnose
title: Start an exam readiness diagnostic
